info.title: NerdCorner API
info.description:
REST API for **NerdCorner**, a forum where users discuss games.

A *game* has many *posts*, and a *post* has many *comments*.

**Authentication:** log in via `POST /auth/login` (or register). The server sets an HttpOnly `access_token` cookie (valid 5 minutes) that must be sent with protected requests (`credentials: 'include'` in browsers); renew it with `POST /auth/refresh`.

**Roles:** anonymous users can read; logged-in users can create posts/comments and edit/delete their own; administrators can manage games and users and delete any post or comment.

**Conventions:** list endpoints are paginated with `?page=`. Successful create/update/delete calls return an empty JSON array `[]`. Errors are always `{ "message": "..." }`. Every operation includes request examples and example responses for each possible result.
